watch.title: Lame-duck session begins
watch.what: The outgoing Congress, still under Republican control, returns for its last weeks. Any bill that hasn't become law by Jan 3 dies and has to be introduced again.

watch.title: Republican leadership elections, House and Senate
watch.what: Both Republican conferences pick their leaders for the next Congress, where they'll be in the minority. Senate voting starts at 9 a.m. in the Old Senate Chamber.
watch.who: House and Senate Republicans, including newly elected members

watch.title: House Democratic leadership elections
watch.what: House Democrats choose their leaders, including their nominee for Speaker. Hakeem Jeffries has announced he's running.
watch.who: House Democrats, including newly elected members

watch.title: Senate Democratic leadership election
watch.what: A secret ballot that includes the newly elected senators. Chuck Schumer says he has the votes; several incoming Democrats have said they'll back someone else.
watch.who: Senate Democrats, including newly elected senators

watch.title: Government funding runs out
watch.what: Congress has to pass full-year spending bills or another stopgap, or a shutdown starts. Health care items such as the expired ACA premium subsidies would most likely ride on this bill.
watch.who: The House and Senate, then the President

watch.title: Last scheduled day of the year
watch.what: The Senate's last scheduled day. The House's last scheduled day is Dec 17. Either can stay longer if work is unfinished.

watch.title: Farm programs fall back to permanent law
watch.what: The farm bill expired Sept 30. The House passed a new one in April, and the Senate hasn't acted. Without action by Dec 31, farm programs revert to decades-old permanent law.
watch.who: The Senate first, then both chambers on a final version

watch.title: 120th Congress convenes
watch.what: Noon Eastern, as the Constitution sets unless Congress passes a law moving the day (Jan 3 is a Sunday). The House elects a Speaker before members are sworn in. Democrats hold majorities in both chambers.

watch.title: House Democrats' first bills
watch.what: House Democrats say they'll bring up bills to rescind tariffs, restore expired ACA premium subsidies and reverse Medicaid cuts, plus a war powers resolution on Iran.

watch.title: Defense policy bill (NDAA)
watch.what: The 2027 defense bill stalled in the Senate in July. Leaders expect a deal after the election.

watch.title: Debt limit could be reached
watch.what: The government could hit its borrowing limit as soon as February, leaving the new Congress to raise or suspend it.
watch.who: The House and Senate, then the President
